_note: spine-plan-v2 §7.2. Page budget stops being prose. check_form.py reads this file: a page whose role carries required blocks and ships without them FAILS, and a page whose role is not in STATE.campaign.pageBudget.core ∪ .depth FAILS. Blocks are detected as data-block="<name>" attributes in the HTML. Keys starting with _ are metadata, not roles.
_roleSource: STATE.pages[].role — the enum in event-intel/STATE-schema.json. A role absent from this file is an unknown role and FAILS.
_depthNote: Depth roles below are built ONLY when STATE.campaign.pageBudget.depth names them (RULES B12). They declare no required blocks until P0 declares them; pageBudget membership is still enforced.

_forbidPatterns._note: Some forbids are not blocks but page-wide text shapes. check_form.py applies these regexes when the role forbids the named token.
_forbidPatterns.axis-not-in-STATE: __RESOLVED_AT_RUNTIME__ compare page axis labels are matched against STATE.campaign.axis

_dirtyMap._note: spine-plan-v2 §7.4 field → page-role map. data/.diff/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json names changed fields; make.sh rebuilds ONLY the roles this map names. An empty diff still bumps factbase.asOf — silence is a bug.
